info.title: OPERA Cloud Leisure Management API

get.summary: Retrieves all available leisure experiences available for scheduling, grouped by types, groups and filtered by search criteria.
get.description:
Retrieves a comprehensive list of leisure experiences offered by the hotel, organized by groups and types. The search criteria can be used to further filter the leisure experiences.

OperationId:getAvailableLeisureExperiences

parameters.name: hotelId
parameters.description: Hotel code of the property to fetch the leisure experiences from.

parameters.name: leisureExperienceCode
parameters.description: The code of the leisure experience for which availability and details to be fetched. Used together with fetchMode - Detail.

parameters.name: beginDate
parameters.description: The start date to fetch the availability slots from.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: The end date to fetch the availability slots upto.

parameters.name: beginTime
parameters.description: The preferred start time for time slot availability. Expects HH:MM 24hour format. e.g., 14:30

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: The preferred end time for time slot availability. Expects HH:MM 24hour format. e.g., 14:30

parameters.name: resourceFeatures
parameters.description: The preferred features to filter available resources by.

parameters.name: resourceCode
parameters.description: The preferred primary resource on the leisure experience.

parameters.name: spaceCode
parameters.description: The preferred space category resource on the leisure experience.

parameters.name: excludeExperienceIds
parameters.description: Unique scheduled experience ids. When passed, the resources held by these schedules will be considered available.

200.description: Response object for fetching available leisure experiences.

get.summary: Searches leisure experiences filtered by experience group, experience types, experience code, and experience name.
get.description:
This API returns the list of leisure experiences and allows filtering by hotel, experience group, experience types, experience code, and experience name.

OperationId:searchLeisureExperiences

parameters.name: hotelId
parameters.description: Hotel code(s) to search leisure experiences. To search across multiple hotels, repeat the parameter. Example: hotelId=PROP1&hotelId=PROP2.

parameters.name: experienceGroup
parameters.description: Leisure experience group code to filter experiences.

parameters.name: experienceTypes
parameters.description: Leisure experience type codes to filter experiences.

parameters.name: experience
parameters.description: Leisure experience code to filter experiences.

parameters.name: experienceName
parameters.description: Leisure experience name to filter experiences. Performs a case-insensitive search.

parameters.name: includeInactive
parameters.description: Flag to include inactive leisure experiences in the response.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of leisure experiences to return in the response.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Index of the first leisure experience to return in the response.

200.description: Response object for searching leisure experiences by group and type.

operationId.description: The operationId of the path you can call to follow this link.  This allows you to look up not only the path and method, but the description of that path and any parameters you need to supply.

warningsType.description: Used in conjunction with the Success element to define a business error.

warningType.description: Used when a message has been successfully processed to report any warnings or business errors that occurred.

shortText.description: An abbreviated version of the error in textual format.

code.description: If present, this refers to a table of coded values exchanged between applications to identify errors or warnings.

docURL.description: If present, this URL refers to an online description of the error that occurred.

status.description: If present, recommended values are those enumerated in the ErrorRS, (NotProcessed Incomplete Complete Unknown) however, the data type is designated as string data, recognizing that trading partners may identify additional status conditions not included in the enumeration.

tag.description: If present, this attribute may identify an unknown or misspelled tag that caused an error in processing. It is recommended that the Tag attribute use XPath notation to identify the location of a tag in the event that more than one tag of the same name is present in the document. Alternatively, the tag name alone can be used to identify missing data [Type=ReqFieldMissing].

recordId.description: If present, this attribute allows for batch processing and the identification of the record that failed amongst a group of records. This value may contain a concatenation of a unique failed transaction ID with specific record(s) associated with that transaction.

type.description: The Warning element MUST contain the Type attribute that uses a recommended set of values to indicate the warning type. The validating XSD can expect to accept values that it has NOT been explicitly coded for and process them by using Type ="Unknown".

rph.description: Reference Place Holder used as an index for this warning.

successType.description: Returning an empty element of this type indicates the successful processing of an message. This is used in conjunction with the Warning Type to report any warnings or business errors.

errorsType.description: An error that occurred during the processing of a message.

errorType.description: Standard way to indicate that an error occurred during the processing of an message. If the message successfully processes, but there are business errors, those errors should be passed in the warning element.

shortText.description: An abbreviated version of the error in textual format.

code.description: If present, this refers to a table of coded values exchanged between applications to identify errors or warnings.

docURL.description: If present, this URL refers to an online description of the error that occurred.

status.description: If present, recommended values are those enumerated in the ErrorRS, (NotProcessed Incomplete Complete Unknown) however, the data type is designated as string data, recognizing that trading partners may identify additional status conditions not included in the enumeration.

tag.description: If present, this attribute may identify an unknown or misspelled tag that caused an error in processing. It is recommended that the Tag attribute use XPath notation to identify the location of a tag in the event that more than one tag of the same name is present in the document. Alternatively, the tag name alone can be used to identify missing data [Type=ReqFieldMissing].

recordId.description: If present, this attribute allows for batch processing and the identification of the record that failed amongst a group of records. This value may contain a concatenation of a unique failed transaction ID with specific record(s) associated with that transaction.

type.description: The Warning element MUST contain the Type attribute that uses a recommended set of values to indicate the warning type. The validating XSD can expect to accept values that it has NOT been explicitly coded for and process them by using Type ="Unknown".

nodeList.description: An XPath expression that selects all the nodes whose data caused this error. Further, this expression should have an additional constraint which contains the data of the node. This will provide the offending data back to systems that cannot maintain the original message.

tags.name: LeisureManagement
tags.description: The Leisure Management module offers a set of APIs to manage the activities for a guest like spa, golf, tours etc. The external system can create, change, cancel activities and send these updates to OPERA Cloud; either attached the activity to the OPERA Cloud Reservation or Profile.

tags.name: LeisureManagementConfig
tags.description: The Leisure Management Configuration module offers a set of operations to manage the configuration of activities like Status codes, locations, types etc. User can create, change, remove and fetch Status codes, locations, types etc.
